meta.description: Hourly. Sends the day 3 / 5 / 8 follow-up templates to leads whose window is due, advances or completes their drip state, and logs every send. Frequency-cap errors (131049) leave the lead active to retry.

parameters.query:
SELECT l.id, l.wa_id, l.drip_stage, l.first_seen_at
FROM leads l
WHERE l.drip_status = 'active'
  AND l.opted_out = false
  AND l.next_touch_at IS NOT NULL
  AND l.next_touch_at <= now()
  AND l.drip_stage < 3
  AND (l.last_inbound_at IS NULL OR l.last_inbound_at < now() - interval '20 hours')
ORDER BY l.next_touch_at
LIMIT 100;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE leads SET
    drip_stage = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'sent' THEN {{ $json.nextStage }} ELSE drip_stage END,
    next_touch_at = CASE
      WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'sent' AND {{ $json.nextStage }} = 1 THEN first_seen_at + interval '5 days'
      WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'sent' AND {{ $json.nextStage }} = 2 THEN first_seen_at + interval '8 days'
      WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'sent' AND {{ $json.nextStage }} = 3 THEN NULL
      ELSE next_touch_at END,
    drip_status = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'sent' AND {{ $json.nextStage }} = 3 THEN 'completed' ELSE drip_status END
  WHERE id = {{ $json.leadId }}
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO message_log (lead_id, direction, channel, template_name, meta_message_id, error_code, body, created_at)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.leadId }}, 'outbound', 'template',
  $tpl${{ $env['DRIP_TEMPLATE_' + $json.nextStage] }}$tpl$,
  NULLIF('{{ $json.msgId }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.errCode }}', ''),
  $b$drip stage {{ $json.nextStage }} status {{ $json.status }}$b$,
  now()
);
